free_tier.stated: Public beta free credits: a general pool with a rolling 5-hour cap of 120,000 credits and a rolling weekly cap of 1,200,000 credits; a separate Flash-Lite pool has 60,000 per 5 hours and 600,000 per week.

record.tooling: OpenAI SDK, Anthropic Messages or OpenAI Responses against token.sensenova.cn/v1
record.chaining: the rolling 5-hour and weekly credit windows bound sustained use; credit burn per model varies

limits.value: general pool 120,000 credits / 5h and 1,200,000 / week (public beta)

identity_cost.detail: quickstart requires account registration and phone-number verification

record.reliability_note: credit windows reset on a rolling basis; a 429 error signals quota or rate exhaustion; beta rules may change

evidence.proved: general credit pool cap rose to 120,000 per 5 hours and 1,200,000 per week
evidence.quote: 滚动 5 小时窗口的上限将由 60,000 积分提升至 120,000 积分；

record.notes: Public-beta free credits are documented with rolling windows; no public read path was probed. Registration requires a phone number, which is an any-phone gate rather than a pure email gate.
